final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor supplied no new admissible evidence and instead reframed the same record more narrowly. That reframing is analytically better: aggregate readiness evidence supports launch viability in general, but the policy separately requires disclosure for a material limitation affecting a named launch use case unless the issue is resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch. On the present record, the mortgage servicing assistant segment still misses target, is named in two servicer pilot commitments, legal review is still open, and no approved risk acceptance is in evidence. That means the caveat is not merely a disclosure note around an otherwise satisfied predicate; it is the unresolved compliance predicate itself. A caveated governance decision may be a more accurate description of management posture, but it is not enough to support a compliant or compliant_with_caveats audit outcome on this record.
remaining_concerns: Materiality remains triggered because the underperforming mortgage servicing assistant segment is named in two servicer pilot commitments.
No admissible evidence shows disclosure occurred, the gap was resolved before launch, or approved pre-launch risk acceptance covers this exact limitation.

Aggregate readiness and general monitoring/model-card guidance do not satisfy the specific policy requirement for a material limitation in a named launch use case.
